scheme_name: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Assistance in Rent to MSEs
other_conditions: Enterprise must be a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE).
Enterprise must be engaged in manufacturing activities.
Business must have acquired a rented or leased shed for its operations.
Shed owner must have legal ownership and possession of the property.
Manufacturing unit must be consuming electricity/power for its activities.
Assistance applicable from the rent deed date or three months prior to production, whichever is later.
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of 65% of rent paid, up to ₹1,00,000 per annum for up to 5 years.
